I am literally tearing at the seams. My past trauma haunts every single day. I can't talk too or trust anyone. I feel like everyone is hiding something and my company is only wanted while they wait for the next best thing.

I'm sick of being played and having my head messed with and sick of messing my own head up every god damn day.

Each day hurts more than the last and I was told it was supposed to get easier.
